Psalms 6 · Psalm 6: O Lord, Rebuke Me Not in Thine Anger

points: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure. Pray to the Most High knowing He does not judge you in His anger; think of Moses and how many times the Most High wanted to destroy the people and start over, yet held back.

note.label: Psalm 6: O Lord, Rebuke Me Not in Thine Anger

points: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am weak; O Lord, heal me, for my bones are vexed. My soul is also sore vexed; but thou, O Lord, how long? David is weak and vexed in body and soul and cries out how long.

note.label: Psalm 6: O Lord, Rebuke Me Not in Thine Anger

points: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul; oh save me for thy mercies' sake. For in death there is no remembrance of thee; in the grave who shall give thee thanks? David pleads for deliverance for the sake of the Most High's mercy.

note.label: Psalm 6: O Lord, Rebuke Me Not in Thine Anger

points: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears. Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies. David is worn down with weeping and grief because of all his enemies.

note.label: Psalm 6: O Lord, Rebuke Me Not in Thine Anger

points: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping. David turns on the workers of iniquity because the Most High has heard his weeping.

note.label: Psalm 6: O Lord, Rebuke Me Not in Thine Anger

points: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer. Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed; let them return and be ashamed suddenly. The Most High receives David's prayer, and his enemies will be put to shame.
